title: 第七章 我亲爱的姐姐，你我荣耀同享
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“姐妹么？这是我从未感受过的感觉。”

白玥的呼吸都变重了。

她想了很多，却唯独没有想到这个答案。

对方并不嫌弃自己是一个废人，也不讨厌自己人魔混血儿的身份，相反的还很喜欢她的存在……

这一切都是因为她们是姐妹。

这……白玥有点恍惚。

她不知如何形容这份情感，因为她之前从未感受过。

白玥的眼眸红了起来，心中涌现出复杂的情绪，“可我们不是同一个母亲。”

“甚至，在今天之前我们连一面都没有见过，只是有着相似血脉的陌生人而已。对于我这个陌生人，你如此的好，让我感到害怕。”

白玥的心中涌现出复杂的情绪来。

她的心情是无法言说的。

原因很简单，白玥遭受过太多的冷眼。

她在牧师圣殿是吃百家饭长大的。

因此，白玥已经习惯了他人的冷漠态度，却没想到这个同父异母的妹妹对自己如此好。

明明她一来，会影响到对方在魔族的地位。

她也听侍女们说过关于枫溪的事情。

在她出现之前，枫溪是魔神皇枫秀的长女，也是魔神皇之位的第一顺位继承人。

她抢走了枫溪的长女之名。

按理来说，枫溪该厌恶她才对。

对于利益、荣耀于一体的魔族之人来说，她的存在就是在挑战枫溪的地位。

换位思考，枫溪的感受是不会很好的。

白玥都做好了接受枫溪讨厌的准备了。

因为从这一点来看，白玥就觉得枫溪对自己肯定会有不满。

偏偏，这个妹妹不按常理出牌。

她真的弄不懂枫溪的想法了。

对方不讨厌自己，相反的还亲近自己，这是白玥绞尽脑汁都没想到的一幕。

按照枫溪所说，这就是所谓的姐妹之情。

这就是姐妹之间的荣耀么？白玥在心中反复念叨着这一行字。

她的心好茫然。

她不懂枫溪态度的转变。

“是啊。”

枫溪肯定地说着，“你是我的姐姐，我的荣耀和你同在。”

“……”

Page (1/3)

"Sisters? This is a feeling I have never felt before."

Bai Yue's breathing became heavier.

She thought a lot, but she didn't think of this answer.

The other party does not dislike her for being a useless person, nor does she hate her identity as a human-demon hybrid. On the contrary, she really likes her existence...

All because they are sisters.

This... Bai Yue was in a trance.

She didn't know how to describe the emotion because she had never felt it before.

Bai Yue's eyes turned red, and complex emotions emerged in her heart, "But we are not the same mother."

"In fact, we have never met before today. We are just strangers with similar blood. To me, a stranger, you are so kind, which scares me."

Complex emotions emerged in Bai Yue's heart.

Her feelings were beyond words.

The reason is simple. Bai Yue has suffered too many cold looks.

She grew up eating hundreds of meals in the priest's temple.

Therefore, Bai Yue has become accustomed to the indifference of others, but she did not expect that her half-sister would be so kind to her.

It is obvious that her arrival will affect the other party's status in the demon clan.

She also heard what the maids said about Maple Creek.

Before she appeared, Fengxi was the eldest daughter of Demon God Emperor Fengxiu and the first heir to the position of Demon God Emperor.

She stole the title of Fengxi’s eldest daughter.

Logically speaking, Fengxi should hate her.

For the people of the demon clan who combine profit and glory, her existence is a challenge to Fengxi's status.

If you think about it from another person's perspective, Fengxi's feelings would not be very good.

Bai Yue was ready to accept Fengxi's dislike.

Because from this point of view, Bai Yue felt that Fengxi would definitely be dissatisfied with him.

However, this sister doesn't play according to common sense.

She really couldn't understand Fengxi's thoughts.

The other party doesn't hate him, but on the contrary, he is close to him. This is a scene that Bai Yue racked his brains and never imagined.

According to Fengxi, this is the so-called sisterly love.

Is this the glory between sisters?Bai Yue repeated this line of words in her heart.

She felt so confused.

She didn't understand Fengxi's change in attitude.

"Yeah."

Fengxi said affirmatively, "You are my sister, and my glory is with you."

"..."
